summary: KLA Corporation filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share. The dividend is payable September 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of August 17, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation as defined. The filing includes the press release as an exhibit. No unusual terms, strategic actions, or special-situations characteristics are present. The dividend is a standard, recurring distribution from operations.
